items.prompt: Why not silence every signed/unsigned warning with static_cast?

options.text: A cast can hide the warning without proving the value fits
options.why: Validate the intended range before a justified conversion.

options.text: Every explicit cast automatically checks financial units
options.why: Casts do not know units or domain intent.

options.text: size_t always represents negative values directly
options.why: It is an unsigned size type.

options.text: Every mixed comparison is a syntax error
options.why: Many such expressions compile and can have surprising meaning.

items.explanation: A deliberate range/sign proof is needed; the absence of the diagnostic after a cast is not the proof.
